desc: Prove that orienting \(1^Y0^X \to 0^X1^Y\) is terminating and confluent, and that two strings are mutually reachable exactly when their normal forms agree.
Correct the run-list normalizer and apply it independently to both S and T before comparison.
Brute-force validate the linked-list bulk normalizer against elementary directed rewriting and BFS reachability on small cases, including threshold/near-threshold runs.
Stress-test long alternating complete-block patterns to confirm practical linear behavior.
Produce the final Python solution with correctness and complexity reasoning.
